final: WITH g AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux, AVG(CASE WHEN s.boxx IS NOT NULL AND s.boxy IS NOT NULL AND s.boxx <> 0 THEN (s.boxy - s.boxx) * 1.0 / s.boxx END) AS avg_rel_diff, AVG(s.aream2) * 1.0 / NULLIF(AVG(s.volm3), 0) AS ratio FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), m AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM g WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT g.fundflux, g.avg_rel_diff, g.ratio, g.ratio - m.avg_ratio AS ratio_above_avg FROM g, m WHERE g.ratio > m.avg_ratio ORDER BY g.ratio DESC
